_note: C4 of 4 - viz units for the narrative layer (landing, tours, verify-a-figure, the paralogy evidence page, validation panels, methods/glossary), the global chrome, and the export/citation machinery. These are the units that make this design an atlas rather than a browser.

viz_units.name: Omnibox typeahead
viz_units.what_it_shows: One search field resolving gene symbols, RefSeq ids, ENSG, ENST, motif strings and cluster ids.
viz_units.encoding: A single input with grouped result sections and a type glyph per row; each row carries a motif-count sparkbar (VU-C1-38) or a mini-logo (VU-C2-30).
viz_units.data_source: BAKE data/search_index.json.gz - 17,847 gene symbols + 18,093 RefSeq + 20,481 ENSG + 20,481 ENST, a measured 1.71 MB raw / 0.42 MB gz for the full index (0.157 MB for the symbol->transcript slice). Built from motif_full_annotations.parquet (gene_symbol, sequence_id) and GRCh37_latest_rna_sequence_pairs_long_transcript.parquet ('Gene stable ID', 'Transcript stable ID', versioned variants). Cluster ids and consensus strings come from clusters_index.json and consensus_meta.csv.
interactions: ⌘K/Ctrl-K from anywhere
entirely client-side - no network round-trip per keystroke
U->T normalisation so the manuscript's own motif names (UCAUC, UCUCC, GCCACC, AGCAGA) resolve
an unmatched symbol falls through to the excluded-transcript register and the did-you-mean list rather than returning nothing

viz_units.encoding: A 28px full-width strip with an ⓘ, two lines of quoted text, the 2,620/166,615 (1.6%) number, and a 'why?' link. Not dismissible.
viz_units.data_source: verbatim from /Users/wangyanz/Desktop/Project/sequence_design/sequence_analysis_v4_0621/03.interacting_modules/module_gene_members/README.md ('These are statistical module memberships (motif co-occurrence), not demonstrated physical interactions.') and results/REPORT.md ('2,620 of 166,615 co-occurring pairs (1.6 %) pass - these are candidate, unvalidated pairs not explained by single-clade structure, not confirmed interactions.')

hovering the quote shows its source file and section
